description: This file defines abstract classes and utilities for MISP objects, including caching, enum types, JSON encoding, and class hierarchies for MISP data structures such as AbstractMISP and MISPTag.
external_files: except ImportError: from json import loads, dumps

classes.name: MISPFileCache
classes.description: Provides a static method for caching JSON data loaded from file paths with a maximum cache size.

classes.name: Distribution
classes.description: Enum representing different distribution levels for MISP data.

classes.name: MISPEncode
classes.description: Custom JSON encoder for serializing MISP objects, datetime, UUID, and Enum instances.

classes.name: AbstractMISP
classes.description: Abstract base class for MISP objects, supporting JSON serialization, dict-like access, and change tracking.

classes.name: MISPTag
classes.description: Class representing a MISP tag, inheriting from AbstractMISP, with additional tag-specific methods.

methods.name: _int_to_str

methods.name: pymisp_json_default
methods.description: Default JSON serialization function for MISP objects and related types.
